name: codemod-target
description: One file of a sweep: make the change, then run the tests that cover it. A sweep over a monorepo is one run of this per file, not one run with many orders — so `workflow_next` offers every outstanding file to whoever asks, and the file path is the run's identity, which is what stops the same file being swept twice.

apply_change.why: make the change described in the sweep, in this one file

verify_change.why: run the tests that cover this file — a change nobody verified is not done

target.description: the file being changed, repo-relative and with forward slashes, e.g. packages/api/src/db.ts
